quests.title: Who Takes the Moor Farm
quests.summary: Farmer Dale's tenancy comes up at lambing and nobody has said who takes the hill farm on. Hear everyone, then tell him straight.

steps.text: Talk to Farmer Dale at Moor Farm.
Ask Joe Hartley at Rosedale Farm what he would do with it.
Hear the moor ranger at the Moorcock Inn.
Tell Farmer Dale what you think.
Wait for word. The post for this end of the moor waits at the Moorcock Inn, a night's sleep or a day later.

quests.reward: A hill farmer's flat cap, a keepsake of how it went, and Dale's mother's parkin recipe.

endings.text: Hannah took Moor Farm on, with a part-time job to keep the roof on. Hill farms have long leaned on a second income, and on flocks that know their own hill.
Joe Hartley took the flock and the tenancy and the flock stayed on its hill. Dale moved to the village, and a shepherd lives in the farmhouse.
Moor Farm went into a habitat scheme: forty ewes, not a hundred and thirty, more heather, and curlews nesting where there were fewer.
